newsitem.title: USA: OpTel completes note, stock financing.
newsitem.headline: OpTel completes note, stock financing.

text.p: OpTel Inc said on Monday it has completed a private financing of $225 million of senior notes due 2005 and 225,000 shares of non-voting common stock.
The senior notes bear interest at 13 percent, will mature on Feb. 15, 2005, and will pay interest semi-annually on February 15 and August 15.

The $219 million in net proceeds will be used to expand the company's customer base, to implement its telecommunications strategy, to repay debt to Groupe Videotron Ltee, fund reserve requirements on the notes and for general corporate purposes, OpTel said.
OpTel offers cable television and telecommunications services to multi-dwelling unit developments with which it negotiates long-term rights of entry.
OpTel is an indirect U.S. subsidiary of Groupe Videotron, international cable and telecommuciations firm based in Montreal.
